description: Older way to apply a code: saves a coupon or a friend's referral code to the cart (null removes both). Send the current version. Prefer coupon_code on quote_cart and create_checkout. Automatic discounts apply either way.

coupon_code.description: A coupon code or a friend's referral code; null removes both.

guest_token.description: Private guest session token from create_cart. Retain for cart, checkout and purchase-status calls; no account login needed.

version.description: The cart's current version, from the last cart result. Each edit increments it.

name: set_cart_coupon
